sources.title: 企業銷售攻勢推動 OpenAI's 季度營收達到 100 億美元，不過仍落後於 Anthropic / Enterprise sales push OpenAI's quarterly revenue to $10 billion, though it still trails Anthropic
sources.title_zh: 企業銷售攻勢推動 OpenAI's 季度營收達到 100 億美元，不過仍落後於 Anthropic
sources.title_en: Enterprise sales push OpenAI's quarterly revenue to $10 billion, though it still trails Anthropic
sources.title_original: Enterprise sales push OpenAI's quarterly revenue to $10 billion, though it still trails Anthropic
sources.summary: OpenAI grew its quarterly revenue 50 percent to $10 billion but is still burning more cash than it brings in. Adjusted operating losses climbed to $10.9 billion, while rival Anthropic operates far more efficiently on $17 billion in revenue. To close the gap, OpenAI is now fueling a price war for enterprise customers. The article Enterprise sales push OpenAI's quarterly revenue to $10 billion, though it still trails Anthropic appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 的季度營收成長 50% 達到 100 億美元，但其現金消耗速度仍然大於進帳。調整後營業虧損攀升至 109 億美元，而競爭對手 Anthropic 憑藉 170 億美元的營收展現了高得多的營運效率。為了縮小差距，OpenAI 目前正在企業客戶市場點燃價格戰。

sources.summary: OpenAI 截至 9 月的第三季營收首度突破 100 億美元，季增近 50%，企業業務單季翻倍，但調整後營業虧損也擴大到 109 億美元。本文把它和同一週啟動 IPO 路演的 Anthropic 放在一起看，對照兩家的成長速度、虧損與營收規模，並帶出 Friar 對解開 Azure 合約的期待。
